name: Bloodmoon
author: Nola Drift
description: Bloodmoon by Nola Drift is a gothic organ with a haunted bell. Every note is a pipe with its 2nd, 3rd and 4th harmonics, and a bell strikes on top of it, a little off the organ, close to a minor third. A slow vibrato fades in after the attack with a faint wobble under it, so held notes drift like old pipes. On screen, a black cathedral under a blood-red moon moves with every knob.
